title: 第3章 修为突破可以师尊先脱衣服第4章 不脱也行不图舒服么
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第3章修为突破可以，师尊先脱衣服小竹峰，苏婉卿洞府之内。
此刻，浴池之内，苏婉卿泡在温润池水之中。
之前的池水都是药液，淬体来用，可如今她已经无法承受那药材的灵力，让换了灵泉。
苏婉卿眼神空洞，但因为楚宁那句三十年河东，三十年河西，心神中再度燃起了一丝斗志。
古来今往了，多少人陨落在了圣人雷劫之中。
她本以为自己足够天才，可以跨越，可仍然是太过自信。
如今已经恢复了一个月，各种丹药都吃过，可仍然无法凝聚灵气。
她知道自己的情况。
灵府破碎了.......
运转灵气的灵脉也碎了，此身已经是残破不堪，怕是寿元都没有太多。
前不久，还是天骄修士，可能成为天下突破速度最快的剑修。
如今，竟然是成了废人，灵气都调动不了。
愤怒，已经愤怒过了，绝望也已经感受到了。
靠在浴池边上，她感受着泉水传来的温度，始终说着唯一留下弟子的那番话。
天无绝人之路。
就是因为这些，宁儿的资质低微，可仍然每天刻苦修炼么？
她从未体会过这种感觉，如今才能切实体会到了楚宁如今的心境是多么的强悍。
弟子，不俗啊，可我已经没有能力让他走的更高了，甚至这小竹峰，看似宗门保留给了她，也一定会一个月甚至半年之内要回来。
一声长叹.......
咚咚咚。

洞府门，忽然被叩响。
苏婉卿立刻警惕起身，披上外衣，手中持剑！
她自知容貌极好，这些年也有无数人追求，甚至宗主也是其中之一！
但她心中只有大道登顶和剑术，对男女情事根本没有任何追求，如今修为尽失，怕不是有人趁机要做些什么！
人心之恶，令人发指！
她不敢放松，一刻都不敢，如果有任何事情发生，她宁愿身死也不遭人凌辱！
甚至此刻，口中含下了一枚丹药，如果对方修为高，她直接吞下，顷刻毙命！
清白之事，远比生命还要重要！
“师尊，您休息了么，弟子为您熬了一碗姜汤。”
洞府外，楚宁撑伞来到苏婉卿洞府前。
说真的，夜里拜访，还是大晚上的.......
是个人都会觉得图谋不轨。
他真没那想法，可好歹刷点贡献点什么的，而且是真的担心苏婉卿如今的状态。
虽然系统有点狗，但他还是正人君子的！
话还没说出多少，洞府门缓缓打开一条缝隙，从中可看到昏黄的灯光和一道仅仅以外衣裹挟娇躯的女子。
她手里持剑，眼神警惕。
楚宁立马挪开视线，展示了一下带来的一盆姜汤。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Cultivation breakthrough is possible. Master, take off your clothes first, Xiaozhu Peak, inside Su Wanqing’s cave.
At this moment, in the bath, Su Wanqing was soaking in the warm water.
The water in the pool before was filled with medicinal liquids for body tempering, but now she could no longer bear the spiritual power of the medicinal materials, so she replaced it with a spiritual spring.
Su Wanqing's eyes were empty, but because of Chu Ning's words, Thirty years to the east of the river, thirty years to the west of the river, a trace of fighting spirit was once again ignited in her heart.
Throughout the ages, how many people have fallen into the saint's thunder calamity.
She thought she was talented enough to make the leap, but she was still too confident.
It has been a month since I recovered, and I have taken various pills, but I still cannot condense the spiritual energy.
She knows her situation.
The spiritual mansion is broken...
The spiritual veins that circulate the spiritual energy are also broken. This body is already in dilapidated condition, and I am afraid that I don't even have much longevity.
Not long ago, he was a Tianjiao cultivator, and he might become the sword cultivator with the fastest breakthrough speed in the world.
Now, he has become a disabled person and cannot mobilize his spiritual energy.
Anger, anger has passed, despair has been felt.
Leaning on the edge of the bath, she felt the warmth from the spring water, and kept saying the words of the only remaining disciple.
There is no perfect way.
Is it because of this that Ning'er, despite her low qualifications, still practices hard every day?
She had never experienced this feeling before, and now she could truly understand how strong Chu Ning was in her current state of mind.
Disciple, that's great, but I no longer have the ability to let him go higher. Even this Xiaozhu Peak, which seems to be reserved for her by the sect, will definitely come back within a month or even half a year.
A long sigh......
Boom, boom, boom.
There was a knock on the cave door suddenly.
Su Wanqing immediately stood up alertly, put on her coat, and held a sword in her hand!
She knows that she has excellent looks, and has been pursued by countless people over the years, even the sect leader is one of them!
But in her heart, she only has the road to the top and swordsmanship, and has no pursuit of love between men and women. Now that she has lost all her cultivation, I am afraid someone will take the opportunity to do something!
The evil in the human heart is outrageous!
She didn't dare to relax, not even for a moment. If anything happened, she would rather die than be insulted!
Even at this moment, she had a pill in her mouth. If the other party had a high level of cultivation, she would swallow it and die instantly!
Innocence is far more important than life!
"Master, have you rested? I made a bowl of ginger soup for you."
Outside the cave, Chu Ning held an umbrella and came to Su Wanqing's cave.
To be honest, visiting at night is still late at night...
Everyone will feel that there is something evil planned.
He really didn't have that idea, but he could at least make some contribution or something, and he was really worried about Su Wanqing's current state.
Although the system is a bit messy, he is still a gentleman!
Before he could say much, the door of the cave slowly opened a crack, from which he could see the dim light and a woman with only a coat wrapped around her delicate body.
She held a sword in her hand and her eyes were alert.
Chu Ning immediately looked away and showed the pot of ginger soup he had brought.
